ablation.name: d8b_dim96_15ep
ablation.notes: D8b: Width scaling via model dimension. base_dim 64->96 (+50% width). Theory: D7b depth scaling failed because more layers over-stylize. D8b scales width instead — wider feature representation at same depth. More neurons per layer = richer style encoding without additional abstraction stages. Same 4 layers, same heads=4, same gate_init=0.3. bs=96 for VRAM safety (dim+50% adds ~2x params, need headroom).
